facts.fact: Adwave states that its AI can create 15 or 30-second TV ad spots showcasing a property's best features.
facts.quote: Platforms like Adwave are a good choice as they use AI to create compelling 15 or 30-second video spots that showcase the property’s best features.

facts.fact: Adwave states that its TV ads can be broadcast across a network of over 100 premium channels.
facts.quote: These ads can then be broadcast across a network of over 100 premium channels, including Hulu, ESPN, and NBC, targeting specific ZIP codes and demographics.

facts.fact: Adwave claims it can create and launch broadcast-quality TV commercials in hours rather than months.
facts.quote: which uses AI to create and launch broadcast-quality TV commercials in hours, not months.

facts.fact: The article recommends launching a concentrated TV ad campaign one to three weeks before an open house.
facts.quote: By launching a concentrated TV advertising campaign one to three weeks prior, you can build significant buzz

facts.fact: The article recommends starting the open house TV campaign 14-21 days before the event.
facts.quote: Start your campaign 14-21 days before the open house to build awareness and peak just before the event.

facts.fact: The article recommends launching the open house campaign one to two weeks before the event.
facts.quote: Launch the campaign one to two weeks before the open house and include the date and location.

facts.fact: The article recommends beginning an agent-focused TV campaign three to four weeks before the open house.
facts.quote: Schedule your agent-focused TV campaign to begin three to four weeks before the open house

facts.fact: The article suggests generating three or four different commercial variations for an open house campaign.
facts.quote: Use Adwave's AI to generate three or four different commercials.

facts.fact: The article was published on January 26, 2026.
Adwave advises developing seasonal open house campaigns 6-8 weeks in advance to allow time for ad creation, media placement, and event coordination.
facts.quote: Develop your seasonal campaigns 6-8 weeks in advance to allow ample time for ad creation, media placement, and event coordination.

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance for a multi-property showcase suggests supplementing a general tour ad with individual 15 or 30-second spots for 2-3 of the most compelling properties.
facts.quote: individual 15 or 30-second spots for 2-3 of the most compelling properties

facts.fact: Adwave's guidance for luxury property showcases suggests considering 60-second TV ad spots to allow a longer storytelling format.
Adwave allows advertisers to target ads to specific age groups, with the page giving 25-40 as an example.
facts.quote: they allow you to target ads to specific age groups (e.g., 25-40)

facts.fact: The page recommends launching a targeted TV ad campaign with Adwave within 24-48 hours after an open house.
facts.quote: Use Adwave to launch a targeted TV ad campaign within 24-48 hours of the open house.

facts.fact: The page recommends mapping a multi-week mobile open house tour with 3 to 7 major stops.
facts.quote: Map out a multi-week tour schedule with 3 to 7 major stops in high-value neighborhoods

facts.fact: The page recommends starting TV ads one to two weeks before a mobile open house arrives in each market.
facts.quote: Schedule your TV ads to begin running one to two weeks before your mobile open house arrives in each market

facts.fact: Adwave states it can launch broadcast-quality commercials on networks including NBC, Hulu, and ESPN using only a property URL (vendor claim).
facts.quote: launch broadcast-quality commercials on major networks like NBC, Hulu, and ESPN with just a property URL

facts.fact: The page cites HGTV, Bravo, and ESPN as popular networks where AI-generated first-time buyer ads can run.
facts.quote: on popular networks like HGTV, Bravo, and ESPN
